name: Tabs
description: Switches between related panels of content in the same place.

props.name: tabs
props.type: { id: string; label: string; content: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The id of the tab selected first. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the tab list.

a11y: tablist, tab and tabpanel roles with aria-selected and aria-controls.
Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump to the ends; only the selected tab is in the Tab order.
The selected tab is shown by an indicator and weight, not color alone.
